authenticity.label: Quality Guide
authenticity.title: How to Identify Authentic Moroccan Black Soap
authenticity.desc: When sourcing bulk Beldi soap, look for these natural characteristics to avoid artificial formulations:

items.title: Texture & Color
items.desc: Soft, jelly-like paste. Colors naturally range from dark brown, olive-green to black.

items.title: Pure Ingredients
items.desc: Saponified olive oil, crushed black olives, and mineral water. No synthetic foaming agents.

items.title: Price Awareness
items.desc: Extremely low prices usually point to diluted soap bases containing high chemical filler concentrations.

items.title: Airtight Packaging
items.desc: Requires dark, airtight containers to preserve active natural antioxidants.

items.title: Ethical Cooperatives
items.desc: Direct Moroccan sourcing supports the cooperative women harvesting the olive orchards.
